requirements.notes: Independently reproduced via git, not just trusting the report's self-claim. The 5 commits dated 2026-07-28 that constitute the audit-baseline phase are c73e621 (chore: add ShipShape audit baseline...), 13b11b5 (docs: add codebase orientation write-up...), 56ae2aa (docs: correct legacy-column claim in CLAUDE.md; surface audit deliverables in README), b516ab7 (docs(audit): commit raw evidence...), and 149873a (audit: configure coverage tooling...). `git show --stat` on each shows every changed path under audit/, memory-bank/, .claude/, .gitignore, or README.md — none under api/, web/, shared/, or terraform/. The improvement phase begins immediately after, on 2026-07-29 (ea2dcd3 onward), and those commits (e.g. d6089be, 200241a, 9aa2d1c, 9f3885c, 4ff19da) DO touch api/ and web/ source — but that is the intended next phase (fixing findings), not the audit phase, so it is not a violation of this rule. One unrelated older commit, 1136dc9 ('fix: Resolve 6 critical production bugs found during audit #165', dated 2026-02-07), predates the ShipShape baseline by about 5 months and refers to a different, earlier audit outside this W4 sprint's scope — excluded from this judgment on that basis. History here is clean and separable, not intertwined.
